hook.text: Man introduces the topic with text overlay 'How to deep clean your car the easy way' and subtitle 'If your car wash has one'.

buyer_problem.text: Car interiors accumulate dirt in hard-to-reach areas like cup holders and center console crevices that standard car washes may not address.

product_intervention.text: Using a vacuum cleaner with attachments and a blue microfiber cloth to vacuum and wipe the center console, cup holders, and gear shift area.

result_demo.text: Frames show the cleaning action being performed but do not show a visible 'after' state of a clean car compared to a dirty one; the creator asks 'good or not?' without showing a verified result.

cta.text: Creator asks viewers 'good or not?' regarding the cleaning method.

mechanism_hypothesis.text: Vacuum suction removes loose debris from tight spaces, while the cloth wipes down surfaces for a deeper clean than a standard wash.

transferability.text: This method could transfer to cleaning other vehicle interiors or household crevices using similar vacuum attachments and cloths.

evidence.observation: Man speaks to camera with text 'How to deep clean your car the easy way' and 'If your car wash has one'.
Person uses a vacuum nozzle to clean the center console cup holder area.
Continued vacuuming of the cup holder area with a blue attachment.
Close-up of vacuum nozzle cleaning the side of the center console near the gear shift.
Arm with blue cloth wipes the area around the gear shift with text 'rest of it'.
Man returns to camera view with text 'good or not?'.
Man speaks to camera with text 'mess'.

limits.text: No before/after comparison is visible; the specific vacuum model is not identified; the effectiveness is not visually proven.
